card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as a dose, a cell count or a number in a web address or citation. It fires on the digit itself, not on units or words.

modes.label: Dose and count digits
modes.description: A digit within a multi-digit dose or blood count value in drug label text.
modes.example: Patients at or above 100 kg weight 1<<6>>2 mg administered subcutaneously every week

modes.label: Digits in web addresses
modes.description: A digit inside a long numeric ID in a URL or citation.

card.plain: It lights up on a digit in the middle of a longer number, like a dose or a lab count, where more digits are still to come.
